title: Toasted
description: Extra tasty textures for the Under The Stars Mod
body:
Just some extra tasty looking treats for [Under The Stars](https://modrinth.com/project/ts0kgmFt), the coziest lil camping mod, I hope you enjoy! I'm happy with how the textures turned out, and I'm kind of curious what Kelp Gelatin would taste like.

Along with all the  item textures, this pack includes custom held item models for the Marshmallows on Sticks.

Check out [Under The Stars](https://modrinth.com/project/ts0kgmFt) and [Lumynity Studios](https://modrinth.com/organization/wB3sOGdI) other cool projects!
